crossRefs.note: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the…
For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy…
But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;
For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ…
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

translations.web: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
translations.bsb: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
translations.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
translations.asv: Did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.
